```{r}
library(tidyverse)

solar_path <- "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyserda_solar_county_year_2026-06-30.csv"

solar <- read_csv(
  solar_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    data_through_date = as.Date(data_through_date),
    interconnection_year = as.integer(interconnection_year)
  )
```



```{r}
sum(solar$source_rows == solar$projects)
sum(solar$source_rows == solar$production_records)
```


```{r}
solar |> 
  count(interconnection_year)
```


```{r}
solar |> 
  # filter(interconnection_year == 2019) |> 
  count(county) |> 
  arrange(n)
```


```{r}
solar |> 
  filter(county == "Bennington" | county == "Wyoming", interconnection_year == 2019 )
```


```{r}
# what is negation of AND?
# OR
solar_cleaned <- solar |> 
  filter(
    !(county == "Bennington" & interconnection_year == 2019)
  )

solar_cleaned_2 <- solar |> 
  filter(
    county != "Bennington" | interconnection_year != 2019
  )

```


## Part B

```{r}
solar |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    counties = n_distinct(county),
    first_year = min(interconnection_year),
    last_year = max(interconnection_year),
    source_rows = sum(source_rows),
    projects = sum(projects),
    capacity_missing_records = sum(is.na(capacity_records)),
    production_missing_records = sum(is.na(production_records))
  )
```


```{r}
library(skimr)
solar_cleaned |> 
  skim()
```


```{r}
solar_cleaned |> 
  filter(source_rows != projects)
```



```{r}
solar_cleaned |>
  count(county, interconnection_year) |> 
  filter(n > 1)
```


```{r}
solar_cleaned |> 
  distinct(county) |> 
  arrange(county)

```


```{r}
solar_cleaned |> 
  filter(projects < capacity_records |
           projects > capacity_records )

solar_cleaned |> 
  filter(projects != capacity_records ) # 15


solar_cleaned |> 
  filter(projects > capacity_records ) # 15
```

```{r}
solar_complete <- solar_cleaned |> 
  filter(interconnection_year <= 2025)
```



```{r}
state_year <- solar_complete |>
  group_by(interconnection_year) |>
  summarise(
    projects = sum(projects),
    capacity_mw = sum(capacity_kwdc) / 1000,
    counties = n_distinct(county),
    # capacity_missing_records = sum(___ - ___),
    # .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    average_kwdc_per_project = 1000 * capacity_mw / projects
  )

state_year

# yearly trend of average_kwdc_per_project
  # x-axis: interconnection_year
  # y-axis: average_kwdc_per_project

# scatter plot
# scatter plot with fitted line
# fitted line
# line chart
# bar chart

state_year |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = interconnection_year,
        y = average_kwdc_per_project)
  ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "lightblue",
           color = "black") +
  theme_minimal()
  # geom_point() +
  # geom_line() 
  # geom_smooth(se = F)

```

state_year |>

```{r}
ggplot(state_year, 
       aes(x = ___, y = ___)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1c5d99") +
  labs(
    title = "New York distributed-solar projects by interconnection year",
    subtitle = "Observed project counts; 2026 excluded as a partial year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Interconnected projects",
    caption = "Source: NYSERDA statewide distributed-solar projects; data through 2026-06-30"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

```{r}

state_year |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = interconnection_year, y = projects)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1c5d99") +
  labs(
    title = "New York distributed-solar projects by interconnection year",
    subtitle = "Observed project counts; 2026 excluded as a partial year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Interconnected projects",
    caption = "Source: NYSERDA statewide distributed-solar projects; data through 2026-06-30"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```



```{r}
county_2025 <- solar_complete |>
  filter(interconnection_year == 2025) |>
  mutate(
    statewide_projects = sum(projects),
    project_share = projects / statewide_projects,
    capacity_mw = capacity_kwdc / 1000,
    average_kwdc_per_project = 1000 * capacity_mw / projects
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(project_share))

final_table <- county_2025 |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  transmute(
    county,
    projects,
    project_share_percent = round(100 * project_share, 1),
    capacity_mw = round(capacity_mw, 1),
    average_kwdc_per_project = round(average_kwdc_per_project, 1)
  )

final_table
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 15

county_2025 |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(y = projects, 
        x = fct_reorder(county, projects)
        # x = county
        )
  ) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2e7d5b") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Ten counties with the most interconnected projects in 2025",
    subtitle = "Counts, not rates; no eligible-building denominator is available",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Projects",
    caption = "Source: NYSERDA statewide distributed-solar projects; data through 2026-06-30"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
